CheckTitle: Ensure Password Policy Enforces Length and Rotation
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Identity domain REST API (read-only admin app role, e.g. Audit Administrator + Security Administrator)
Description: Password policies for Fusion and EPM users should require at least 14 characters, block reuse of the last 5 passwords, expire administrative passwords within 365 days and lock accounts after 5 failed sign-ins. Upgraded Fusion and EPM environments configure this in the OCI IAM identity domain; pre-upgrade Fusion uses the Security Console password policy.
Risk: Short, never-expiring or reusable passwords make credential guessing and reuse of leaked passwords practical.
AuditProcedure: Identity domain: Domains > Security > Password policy. Confirm minimum length >= 14, expiry <= 365 days, history >= 5, lockout after <= 5 failed attempts.
Pre-upgrade Fusion: Tools > Security Console > Administration > Password Policy, same thresholds.
Check that lockout duration and auto-unlock meet organisational policy.

Steps: Set minimum length 14, history 5, expiry 365 days and lockout after 5 failed attempts in every active password policy.
Pre-upgrade Fusion: apply the same values in the Security Console password policy and tell users about the change.

DefaultValue: Fusion defaults to an 8-character minimum with no rotation or reuse prevention.
Notes: Length >= 14 and expiry <= 365 days come from the OCI identity checks (minimum length 14, expiry within 365 days) run on the identity domain's password policies. History >= 5 and lockout <= 5, which CIS also requires, are checked here. System Simple/Standard policies are skipped.
